wrong topic: education schemes (Unnat Bharat Abhiyan)

patterns: APPSC asks SAGY repeatedly: MPs select villages; launched 11 Oct 2014 on Jayaprakash Narayan's birth anniversary.
Funding-share one-liners (Rurban mission 60:40) and implementing body (Gram Panchayat for MGNREGA) recur.
Target-group items: PM SVANidhi = street vendors; PM Vishwakarma excludes fishermen; DAY-NULM-UNDP partnership.
APPSC also asks current-affairs numbers (MoHUA garbage-free cities sanction for AP, Microsoft-DGT MoU) - month-year specific.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement items on scheme features, merger lineage (JRY, SGSY, NRLM) and VB-G RAM G dates; deeper than the PYQs.
